answer: Invitation-tree clawback: a new account needs an inviter who locks 150 points on the wharf side of the ledge for 8 epochs, and if the invitee is flagged as a duplicate operator the inviter's lock is burned and the inviter's own invites freeze. Each extra fake costs another 150 locked points, so attacker cost grows linearly, and chained fakes also freeze the whole branch. Weakness: a patient attacker can seed a nectar-sweet honest-looking tree and wait out the lock.
